company.name: Lithic
company.shortDescription: Lithic is a financial technology startup that provides virtual cards and a card issuing platform for businesses and consumers.
company.description: Lithic utilizes virtual cards to allow consumers and businesses to prioritize privacy and safety and not compromise their sensitive financial information. Lithic makes it simple to create payment cards to enable and control spending.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables businesses to programmatically issue virtual, physical, and tokenized payment cards through APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Card Issuing Platform

productsAndServices.description: API-driven issuance of transaction-ready virtual cards with customizable spend controls for B2C and B2B use cases.
productsAndServices.name: Virtual Card Issuance

productsAndServices.description: Programmatic issuance and shipping of customized or templated physical payment cards through API integration.
productsAndServices.name: Physical Card Issuance

productsAndServices.description: Provision and manage payment cards for use in Apple, Google, and Samsung digital wallets with centralized token management.
productsAndServices.name: Tokenized & Digital Wallet Cards

productsAndServices.description: Initiate same-day and next-day ACH payments using routable virtual bank accounts for fund transfers and disbursements.
productsAndServices.name: ACH & Money Movement

productsAndServices.description: Customizable real-time transaction authorization logic using detailed transaction data to accept or decline payments.
productsAndServices.name: Authorization Decisioning
